stepExplanation: Separated populations evolved independently because: (1) **No gene flow** - no exchange of alleles between populations, (2) **Different mutations** - random mutations occurred independently, (3) **Different selection pressures** - different environments on each rim selected for different traits, (4) **Genetic drift** - random changes in allele frequencies in each population.
